name: Transform to Fly Brainrot
desc:
🕊️ Welcome to Transform to Fly Brainrot!

✨ BIG UPDATES EVERY SATURDAY!

How to Play:

🪽 Fly High: Equip your wings and explore the massive map!

🤪 Transform: Become your favorite Brainrot characters!

🧬 EVO Evolution: Be there when a Legendary EVO spawns! Upgrade your Brainrots to the max—exclusive to this game!

💸 Collect & Level Up: Collect and upgrade your Brainrots to reach higher levels and gain more power!

🏆 Flex Your Rarity: Show off legendary Brainrot forms like the Dragon Cannelloni to the world!

🔄 Rebirth: Rebirth to unlock bigger, better, and more luxurious wings!

🎁 EXTRAS:

⭐ PREMIUM BENEFITS: Get a +10% Cash boost!

👍 JOIN THE GROUP: Like the game and join our group for a special in-game reward!
